narrative.overview:
This is an Experience-mode portfolio: the work and the person should feel like an artifact being inspected, not a product funnel being optimized. The composition borrows from an editorial archive and an engineering notebook—large declarative headlines, quiet metadata, thin rules, compact tags, and generous paper around the evidence.

The visual system is restrained and practical. Soft paper and dark ink establish the field; electric blue is deliberately scarce and carries action, status, and small moments of emphasis; rust adds a single warmer counterpoint in project storytelling. Manrope gives the page a contemporary, humane reading voice, while IBM Plex Mono marks system labels, navigation, dates, stacks, and other evidence-like metadata.
keyCharacteristics: Experience-mode portfolio with an editorial engineering archive composition
Warm-neutral paper field, dark ink, restrained electric-blue accent, and rust support
Oversized left hero with a quiet right identity rail
Thin rules, compact tags, three project cards, timeline experience, workflow strip, and contact close
Flat-by-default surfaces with responsive motion and visible keyboard focus

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Blue is a signal: reserve it for action, direction, status, selection, and readable emphasis. Do not turn the page into a blue brand field.

rules.name: The System Label Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono for interface evidence—navigation, status, dates, stack tags, and labels—not for long-form reading.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Let rules, tonal paper, and spacing create structure. Shadows appear only as a subtle interactive response on project cards.

dos: Do let the artifact lead: use oversized left-led statements, quiet metadata, and generous paper around evidence.
Do use thin rules, tonal paper shifts, and whitespace to make hierarchy visible before adding decoration.
Do keep Manrope for display/body reading and IBM Plex Mono for concise system labels.
Do keep electric blue scarce and purposeful; use rust as a supporting project note.
Do preserve the responsive narrative: stack columns at `900px`, switch navigation at `768px`, and tighten the composition at `640px`.
Do provide semantic structure, descriptive link labels, keyboard-visible focus, accessible contrast, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glassy cards, rounded panels, or decorative imagery that compete with the archive composition.
Don't turn tags into noisy controls or use mono for paragraphs and long-form copy.
Don't use the electric-blue accent as a full-page background or on every interactive element.
Don't hide keyboard focus, remove the sticky-header scroll offset, or depend on hover-only meaning.
Don't animate layout or scrolling when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active; transitions collapse to near-zero duration.
